name: Media Merge
description: Combine local video and audio into MP4 or MKV through plugin operations without re-encoding.
missingStreams: The selected files must provide a video track and an audio track. Check the files and try again.
operationDescription: Bring your video and audio together in one file, without re-encoding.
videoInputHint: The picture for your merged file
audioInputHint: The sound for your merged file
outputNotice: Use a new filename; existing files cannot be overwritten. If MP4 is incompatible, try MKV.
serverNotice: Select files on the Motrix server. Files on this computer are not uploaded.
